_doc: Raw library shots. Each: 10 s, eased start/end (smootherstep), params = [lat, lon, slant range km, heading deg (0 = north up), tilt deg from nadir]. Camera looks at lat/lon.

S01_orbit_limb.note: Orbit, Earth limb and atmosphere at top, SE Asia below

S02_region_nadir_push.note: Region top-down: Singapore, Jakarta, Belitung all in frame (flights)

S04_belitung_rotate.note: Whole Belitung island, slow rotation + push (title)

S05_belitung_sw_dive.note: Dive toward Belitung's SW coast, real clouds of the day pass below

S06_seliu_topdown.note: Seliu + Teluk Gembira straight down, slow push and turn (map-like reading)

S07_seliu_arc.note: Oblique arc around Seliu (70 deg), parallax with real clouds

S08_pier_to_seliu.note: From Teluk Gembira jetty looking west toward Seliu: the crossing, slow dolly in (vertical-friendly)

S09_seliu_hold.note: Final 3/4 composition (Seliu left, jetty right), almost still: room for titles
